name: Website Contact Extractor
title: Website Contact Extractor: Emails, Phones, Socials per Site
uses: Sales and agency teams turning a list of company domains into emails, phones and social profiles
Local business lead lists: clinics, law firms, contractors, restaurants
CRM enrichment with one clean row per company website
AI agents that need a company's official contact details as JSON

inputs.name: startUrls
inputs.title: Websites
inputs.description: Websites or domains to extract contacts from, one per line. Examples: https://www.example.com or example.com. Each site becomes exactly one output row.

inputs.name: maxPagesPerSite
inputs.title: Max pages per site
inputs.description: How many pages to read on each site, starting with the homepage and then the most likely contact pages (Contact, About, Team, Impressum, Support). You pay per site, not per page, so higher values only cost more time.

inputs.name: defaultCountry
inputs.title: Default phone country
inputs.description: Two-letter country code used to read local phone numbers that have no +country prefix, e.g. US, GB, DE, AU.

inputs.name: checkMx
inputs.title: Check email domains for MX records
inputs.description: Adds a free DNS check that each email domain can receive mail. Flags typos and dead domains.

inputs.name: respectRobotsTxt
inputs.title: Respect robots.txt
inputs.description: Skip pages that a site's robots.txt asks crawlers not to visit.

inputs.name: proxyConfiguration
inputs.title: Proxy
inputs.description: Optional. Most business sites work without a proxy. Turn on Apify Proxy if many sites time out or block requests.

description: Extract emails, phone numbers, social media links and addresses from any list of websites. One clean deduplicated row per site, Cloudflare-protected emails decoded, phones validated, MX checked. Pay only for sites where an email or phone is found.
